Commentary.Commentary: West Indies now have an uphill task in front of them. Can they show more application than the first two games and put up a fight? Or will the Bangla Tigers complete a 3-0 whitewash? All answers coming up shortly.

West Indies bowlers started well with the ball as they got the wicket of Liton Das in the first over. But they did allow the Bangladeshi batsmen to build partnerships and allowed easy strike rotation. The debutant Harding was expensive in his first outing as he finished wicketless. Alzarri Joseph was the pick of the bowlers with 2 wickets. Mayers and Reifer bowled well in patches as they finished with 1 and 2 wickets respectively. Akeal Hossain, the left arm spinner bowled tightly but would be disappointed as he couldn't eke out a wicket on this slow pitch.

Bangladesh after put into bat lost Liton Das early. But Tamim and Shanto managed to keep the scoreboard ticking by playing some lovely shots. Shanto though was dismissed by a good ball from Mayers. Then the duo of Shakib and Tamim played nicely as both of them completed their respective fifties. But just when they would have thought of converting it into a big score, both of them got out. Mushfiqur Rahim looked at all ease and scored a brilliant 64 runs and also got good support from Mahmudullah, who too played a vital knock of 64 in the end to propel Bangladesh to 297. They would now hope that their bowlers continue the good work from the previous matches.

So Bangladesh for the first time batting first this series have managed to put on a score of 297-6 in their 50 overs, courtesy half tons from four batsmen, Tamim, Shakib, Rahim and a late cameo from Mahmudullah. The inexperienced West Indies bowling line up tried their best but would be disappointed not to restrict Bangladesh under 250.

We are all set to begin. West Indies players have taken their positions in the field. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das are the two Bangladesh openers. Alzarri Joseph to start with the ball. Players from both the teams first take a knee in support of 'Black Lives Matter' movement. Here we go....

Bangladesh skipper, Tamim Iqbal says they are looking to grab the 10 points from this match are are hungry to win this match. They will look to put a decent total on the board and then defend it. Taskin and Saifuddin replace Rubel and Hasan Mahmud.

Jason Mohammed, West Indies skipper, says they will bowl first. Adds that they will look to chase the score put up by Bangladesh. Mentions that they have made a couple of changes as Keon Harding and Jahmar Hamilton come in.
Pitch Report - Anjum Chopra says runs will be on offer in this pitch. She adds that it looks like a good batting track.

Russell Domingo is down for an interview. He says they are happy with the series win but wants the points for this match, without making any wholesale changes. They are happy to play cricket after a long time. Adds they have been professional in both the matches. Adds that they will look to get a big score at Chattogram.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Liton Das, Tamim Iqbal (C), Najmul Hossain Shanto, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Soumya Sarkar, Mahmudullah, Mohammad Saifuddin (IN FOR HASAN MAHMUD), Mehidy Hasan, Taskin Ahmed (IN FOR RUBEL HOSSAIN), Mustafizur Rahman.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Sunil Ambris, Kjorn Ottley, Jahmar Hamilton (WK) (IN FOR JOSHUA DA SILVA), Jason Mohammed (C), Kyle Mayers, Nkrumah Bonner, Rovman Powell, Raymon Reifer, Keon Harding (IN FOR ANDRE MCCARTHY), Alzarri Joseph, Akeal Hosein.
TOSS - It is time for the spin of the coin. West Indies win the toss and elect to field first.

Welcome to the third and final ODI between Bangladesh and West Indies at Chattogram. The series has already been sealed By Bangladesh with absolute no contest from the Caribbean team. Although, many big names are missing from the Windies line up, they would still rule the fact that they have failed to compete in both the previous matches. Can a change in venue, bring change of fortunes for the West Indies? Or will the Bangla Tigers complete a 3-0 whitewash? Toss and team updates coming to you shortly.
